Unresolved Minor prewar/MM end dates, Minor1000 body-specific period, MS end date and conflicting export-production boundaries remain null.
Morris Metro/Princess badge periods not resolved; not guessed. Race-only cars, prototypes, heavy trucks/buses and military specials excluded.
Selected exhibit-scoped technical facts and individually reviewed Commons photos appended separately; no complete engine table claim.
No exhaustive production-history, trim, engine/gearbox or photo coverage claim. Many early branches remain identity-only.
Museum values are exhibit/year/body scoped. No bhp-to-kW or imperial conversions were made. Museum 1929 Minor technical values rejected as apparent later-car transposition.
